adminB.databaseQuery:
-- READ ONLY. Actual final UI job and publication receipt UUIDs only.
with params as (
 select 'b5d68d78-6495-45d6-95d9-909af20a55cb'::uuid job_id,'06ffd737-36a6-4b0c-8b5a-f61657bd1552'::uuid release_id,
 'a7578e86-2f62-482f-9ff2-d671406aec68'::uuid publication_id,
 '1e4c5e99-e387-41aa-a6d3-cbe74558f766'::uuid org_id,
 'bbd25101-b14a-4967-ac5d-fa78054d4f2e'::uuid supplier_id,
 '72cb646e-658d-4775-b3bb-b0799eaa9913'::uuid brand_id
), job as materialized (
 select j.id,j.organization_id,j.audience,j.export_type,j.status,j.scope,j.row_count,j.progress_done,j.progress_total,
 j.byte_size,j.file_name,j.created_at,j.started_at,j.finalized_at,j.failed_at,j.error_message,j.data_version,
 s.id snapshot_id,s.status snapshot_status
 from public.app_export_jobs j cross join params p
 left join export_snapshot_private.snapshots s on s.job_id=j.id
 where j.id=p.job_id
), source as materialized (
 select r.normalized_code,r.product_code,r.buy_price,r.valid_from
 from public.supplier_price_release_rows r cross join params p
 where r.release_id=p.release_id and r.row_status='accepted'
), page as materialized (
 select a.* from params p cross join job j cross join lateral public.cloud_admin_price_list_page_fast(
 p.org_id,p.brand_id,j.scope->>'priceListType',
 (j.scope->>'marginPercent')::numeric/case when j.audience='portal' then 100 else 1 end,null,null,1000) a
), checked as (
 select r.*,src.buy_price,src.valid_from,pg.product_code expected_code,pg.description expected_description,
 pg.lifecycle_status expected_lifecycle,j.scope,j.audience,
 md5((select string_agg(octet_length(v)::text||':'||v,'' order by ord)
 from unnest(array[coalesce(payload->>'code',''),coalesce(payload->>'description',''),
 trim_scale((payload->>'price')::numeric)::text,coalesce(payload->>'priceDate',''),
 case when payload->>'discontinued'='true' then 'Discontinued'||case when coalesce(payload->>'replacementCode','')<>''
 then '; replacement: '||(payload->>'replacementCode') else '' end else 'Active' end]) with ordinality f(v,ord))) row_hash
 from export_snapshot_private.rows r cross join job j left join source src on src.normalized_code=r.source_key
 left join page pg on pg.normalized_code=r.source_key where r.snapshot_id=j.snapshot_id
), summary as (
 select clock_timestamp() observed_at,count(*) row_count,count(distinct source_key) distinct_codes,
 md5(string_agg(row_hash,'' order by ordinal)) ordered_fields_md5,
 count(*) filter(where payload->>'brand' is distinct from 'Geba' or payload->>'currency' is distinct from 'EUR') scope_mismatches,
 count(*) filter(where buy_price is null) missing_prices,
 count(*) filter(where (payload->>'price')::numeric is distinct from round(buy_price*(1+(scope->>'marginPercent')::numeric/case when audience='portal' then 100 else 1 end),2)) price_mismatches,
 count(*) filter(where payload->>'priceDate' is distinct from valid_from::text) date_mismatches,
 count(*) filter(where payload->>'code' is distinct from expected_code or payload->>'description' is distinct from expected_description
 or coalesce(payload->>'discontinued','false') is distinct from case when expected_lifecycle='discontinued' then 'true' else 'false' end) presentation_mismatches,
 (select count(*) from source) eligible_source_keys,
 (select count(*)=1 and bool_and(ptr.publication_id=p.publication_id and ptr.release_id=p.release_id)
 from public.supplier_current_price_pointers ptr cross join params p where ptr.organization_id=p.org_id and ptr.supplier_id=p.supplier_id and ptr.brand_id=p.brand_id) exact_current_pointer,
 (select count(*)=1 and bool_and(j.organization_id=p.org_id and j.status='finalized' and j.error_message is null
 and j.row_count=108 and j.progress_done=108 and j.progress_total=108 and j.byte_size>0 and j.finalized_at is not null
 and j.scope->>'brandId'=p.brand_id::text and j.scope->>'brandName'='Geba' and j.scope->>'format'='xlsx'
 and j.snapshot_status='sealed' and ((j.audience='admin' and j.export_type='admin_price_list') or (j.audience='portal' and j.export_type='portal_price_list'))
 and j.created_at>=pub.published_at) from job j cross join params p left join public.supplier_price_publications pub on pub.id=p.publication_id) finalized_job_bound
 from checked
)
select jsonb_build_object('job',(select to_jsonb(j) from job j),'source',to_jsonb(s),
 'snapshot_acceptance_passed',coalesce(row_count=108 and distinct_codes=108 and eligible_source_keys=108 and scope_mismatches=0
 and missing_prices=0 and price_mismatches=0 and date_mismatches=0 and presentation_mismatches=0
 and exact_current_pointer and finalized_job_bound,false)) evidence from summary s;

No successful root Save click is claimed for this first file.
browserReportedByRoot.adminBDirectRetry: Root clicked the normal Download again link on fa8e8be, observed native Save for (3), clicked Save successfully, and observed the window close.
browserReportedByRoot.customerA: Root selected Geba and Download Excel in the authenticated fa8e8be Ersen portal, observed Preparing then Done with 108 rows, and directly observed the new (2) file in Chrome Recent Download History as Done. No root native Save click is claimed for A; the exact file is independently verified.
browserReportedByRoot.customerSession: Root reloaded the existing authenticated Ersen portal to fa8e8be; Logout remained visible without an authentication prompt.

screenshotReview.observed: Production portal fa8e8be URL, 108-row download-started message, retained native Download again link, Chrome Recent Download History showing A (2) Done and B (2)/(3). This is screenshot inspection, not personal operation of the browser.

noRefetchProof: Native repeat Save is runtime evidence. Reuse without refetch/regeneration is source and local-test evidence; no browser network trace is claimed.
coverage: GEBA108 production admin B15 and authenticated Ersen customer A10 saved files after guarded v2 publication; complete five-column source/snapshot parity.
limits: 108 rows are a commercial acceptance canary, not a production throughput benchmark.
